messages:
Jamal: Heads up — kicking off a small recompute for aggregate-hours (EU) to patch some late-event gaps we saw in last 48h. Need a quick decision on routing + quota override for priority lane.
Anika: How small is small? any estimate on token / cpu cost?
Jamal: ~120 shards, expected ~2.5k tasks, ~= 60k agg units (ballpark). Should finish within a couple hours if we let it use priority lane.
Taylor: Console UX question — if we bump to priority lane do we show a temporary tag and estimated cost to tenant owners? we should avoid surprise billing.
Maya: SLO concern: if priority lane steals slots we'll risk slightly higher latency for Dedicated jobs. But ops impact looks low for a 2h run.
Devon: API/route debate: do we route by "priority=true" on Recompute API or create a separate endpoint? routing middleware will need to respect quota buckets.
Anika: prefer a query param (priority=true) so the console can toggle without new endpoint. We just need a guard in the quota allocator.
Jamal: agree on param. Plan: use priority param + console checkbox, allocator will consult per-tenant override: allow_priority_recompute. Fallback -> normal lane.
Taylor: I can add a console badge + a confirm modal: "Run in priority lane (may use reserved capacity)" with link to cost estimate.
Maya: add a small SLI spike watch: cpu_p95 and host-latency for Dedicated for the next 3h. Alert to #eng-sre if >5% regression.
Devon: also need to ensure KV cache is warmed for these shards, add fast-warm flag or prefetch step. otherwise recompute will thrash cold caches and inflate cost.
Jamal: good call. I'll add a prefetch step and a short cool-down between shard groups.
OpsBot: Job created: recompute-eu-6333333333, job_id=rb-2024-07-12-0842, priority=true
infra-bot: alloc: reserved-pool-eu assigned 12 slots, estimate ETA 1h45m; logs -> https://internal/ops/recompute/rb-2024-07-12-0842
Anika: tagging owners: @MfgTeam and @BillingTeam — please FYI since this touches cost routing.
Taylor: I'll push UI prototype in the console branch and post screenshots in ~20m.
Jamal: TL;DR: param-based priority, console checkbox + cost modal, prefetch warm step, SLI watch + alert, fallback to normal lane. Proceeding to start canary of 10 shards now. Ping if any objections. :thumbsup:
Maya: +1
Devon: +1, monitor cache miss rate closely
Anika: +1, I will notify billing owners and watch the cost dashboard
Jamal: starting canary now. will post progress and final results when done.
